google_reviews.author: Cynthia Smith
google_reviews.text:
I almost left one star off for location, not because of where it actually is but because the location ON GOOGLE MAPS thinks you should drive off the side of the mountain and find a hotel in the middle of some trees. (Then I realized that would make the general star rating go down, which would NOT be fair to the kind people that run the hotel!) anyway, that’s not where this place is, lol; it’s in town. I had to ask directions from about 17 people. I nearly crashed into a car going in the opposite direction where the road is technically two ways but is barely wide enough for ONE car and there is nowhere to pull to the side on thin, winding mountain roads—that are made of gravel, of course. I almost lost my life when I went slightly off-road to avoid crashing into a surprise donkey that flew into the road out of nowhere… and then my car wouldn’t reverse to keep me from going over a four-foot drop and into a tree if I moved at all.

10/10 adventure just finding the place!

Anyway, onto the hotel itself. My room is small but cozy; it was very cold when I got here but the little space heater got to WORK and warmed me (and the whole room) in no time at all. The bed is very comfy and the comforter makes it a warm, happy place to sleep. After the stress of getting here, I conked out completely. When I arrived last night, the fella that brought me to my room asked what time I wanted breakfast, and I slept so hard that they had to knock on my door quite a few times to wake me up so they could say breakfast was ready. 😂

And re: breakfast… DELICIOUS. There was orange juice and a pot of some kind of spiced black tea. There was a couple of boiled eggs. The was sliced fresh bread (I wanna say it was sourdough). There was fruit. There was fresh, obviously homemade Albanian flatbread with several options to put on it: marmalade (not sure what fruit it was made from; I just know it was incredibly tasty), a big block of what I think was feta cheese, and most importantly…. a bowl of honey. The flatbread with honey on it was IMMACULATE. I think my soul left my body and I ascended to a higher plane when I ate it. Coming to Albania was worth it JUST to eat the flatbed topped with honey! Being alive on this earth in such difficult times is worth it because of that flatbread + honey. My plan for the day was to eat breakfast and then drive around and explore, but I ate so much food (most of it just a million pieces of that flatbread) that I came back to my room and took an involuntary nap.

Anyway, the bottom line here is STAY AT THIS HOTEL. The staff don’t speak much English, but that’s fine—this is Albania, not England. I cannot tell you how delightful my stay has been! The view is beyond gorgeous, too; I wasn’t sure where to mention that in my review above. I’m attaching photos of the view, especially from the window and the balcony, breakfast (with an emphasis on the flatbread because omg!), and the room (apologies for the mess—I forgot to take a picture while it was still clean).

***I want to add that this review was not sponsored in any way. I’m just impressed and still full of that AGGRESSIVELY yummy flatbread! 😂❤️❤️❤️***

google_reviews.text:
A mixed experience
The room was advertised as available from 11:00 AM, and we indicated our arrival time was around 12:30 PM. We finally found the house at 1:00 PM, after several attempts to contact the host, and received a reply to our message after 45 minutes.
At 1:15 PM, the room wasn't ready. We left for lunch to allow time for the cleaning to be completed, but when we returned an hour and a half later, it still wasn't ready. We had to ask the person in charge of cleaning to leave the room so we could settle in.
During our stay, we crossed paths with Agostin several times, but he didn't speak to us. His wife, on the other hand, remained polite and courteous. The accommodation has potential, but the welcome and organization need improvement for a better experience.

google_reviews.text:
Basically this is a meadow for setting up tents, and that's it. Probably the the personel was ok, otherwise i would give 0 rating.
What's wrong?
-not enough toilets. There are two toilets for the whole camp. The toilets are at the same time showers. And are not regularily cleaned.
-bad showers. No showerheads, warm water only from 17 to 20 o'clock. No hangers for clothes. Since they are toilets at the same time it gets pretty mudy.
-dishwashing is only one tap, with cold water.
-reception is not marked but it's in the restaurant next to it. They will make sure you pay by walking around rhe tents in the afternoon.
-stray dogs chasing and barking around tents throughout the night.
The views are nice, but you can get them elsewhere, the 15 euros for 2 persons here are not well spent (tent only).

google_reviews.text:
We initially booked the room with the fireplace, the most expensive one. The room was beautiful, but as soon as we lit the fireplace, we had to ask to change rooms because the whole place was filled with smoke and we couldn't breathe. Aleks told us it was "healthy" 😂
We asked for the room with the hot tub instead, for the same price. It took us two hours to fill it—literally!—just a trickle of water came out, and when we finally managed it, it was freezing cold because the heater had burned out. 🥹 Honestly, a disappointment. It's best to rent the cheapest room because nothing else works. There's a lot of mud, especially in winter, so I always recommend wearing good boots. Finding the accommodation is tricky; it's signposted on the left side of the road as you approach, but you can't see it at night, so pay attention. We got lost. There's no gas station until you arrive, and the road is long and winding, so it's advisable to fill up your tank beforehand.

google_reviews.author: Kefin
google_reviews.text:
We stayed a few nights in one of the building in this villa complex. Overall, it was an interesting experience and kind of worth it for the right weather. We visited in early falls/late summer, so the nights are pretty chilly. In our unit, they only have wood stove for the heat, no electric/gas heater, and at that time, they could not turn on the wood stove yet. So, I guess if you come in the summer, the place would be way more bearable.

Also, the whole village of Theht has unreliable electricity, so expect power outage a few times at night during your stay.

The host was responsive to our questions and requests. The breakfast they provided were a nice homemade spread, the butter was homemade freshly churned and the honey is local, the tomato was tasty!

Of course, we all came in for the view which was beautiful!

reviews.author: Alex Krátký
reviews.text_en: We really enjoyed the accommodation with the great hosts, breakfast and dinner were excellent, even though some elements were repeated (but for three nights it was just right). The hosts were really kind and constantly made sure if we were missing anything (e.g. if we were cold at night etc.). The only thing that bothered me was the worse ventilation in the bathroom and therefore a large humidity was held in it, and consequently also in the room.

google_reviews.author: i8trc /Ns
google_reviews.text:
I spent two of the most wonderful days of my life with a kind and welcoming family. The atmosphere was filled with warmth and simplicity, and I truly felt as if I were among my own family. They never stopped making sure I was comfortable and happy, always offering the best of what they could.
The father, in particular, was a true example of generosity and care—always smiling, always attentive, and eager to provide everything I might need. Those days will remain a beautiful memory in my heart, reminding me that true generosity is not measured by what is given, but by the kindness and sincerity behind it.

google_reviews.text: Beautiful place, rooms are a bit noisy but the food here is good and plentiful. Breakfast is also good.

google_reviews.author: Manu

Highly recommended!
We were welcomed into a truly special setting and had three wonderful nights there. The room is simply furnished but perfectly adequate. The vegetarian breakfast and dinner were truly delicious, and the family's hospitality was second to none.
We'd love to come back!!

google_reviews.text:
A very nice place to stay in the Albanian mountains. The host family is very friendly, and the breakfast and dinner are excellent. We would definitely book this accommodation again!

The access road is a bit bumpy, a small gravel/stone track.

google_reviews.author: P
google_reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places we have ever been. The location is great, the accommodation is great, the service is very accommodating and the food is extremely delicious. Absolutely recommended! In addition, a big praise to Alex, who takes care of everything and everyone with a very sympathetic manner.

google_reviews.author: Murat
google_reviews.text:
This place is unbelievably quiet and peaceful. We visited during the winter season and on a weekday. There was no one around except for horses and lovely dogs.
Alex, who takes care of the hotel, is a wonderful person. He is extremely helpful in every way. I would like to thank him once again for making our stay so enjoyable.
I strongly recommend this place to everyone. You certainly won’t regret it.

google_reviews.author: Alina Zinchenko
google_reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay here - it was honestly one of the best places we have ever stayed in our lives. Everything was perfect from start to finish.
The villa is beautiful, very well maintained and spotlessly clean. It felt incredibly comfortable and welcoming.

Breakfast was included and it was absolutely delicious and very filling, with generous portions.

If you’re wondering whether to book dinner, don’t hesitate - you absolutely should. For just €15 you get an enormous portion, with a choice of meat, and the food is incredibly tasty and satisfying.

The staff were exceptionally kind, warm, and attentive, making our stay even more special.

A special mention to the dogs on the property - they are incredibly friendly, sweet, and added so much warmth and joy to the whole experience.

As a small suggestion for the future, it would be great if the villa windows had mirrored or reflective glass for extra privacy, so people passing by wouldn’t be able to see inside.

This was truly an unforgettable stay, and without a doubt one of the best experiences we’ve ever had. We would love to come back and highly recommend this place.

google_reviews.author: Paolo Cappelletti
google_reviews.text: Beautiful location. We had no problems, but those with limited navigation skills might have some difficulty finding the property due to the poor signage (a fairly common occurrence in Albania). The chalet itself is refined. Dinner and breakfast are the property's highlights, as you can enjoy them while overlooking the beautiful scenery of the mountain range and the Theth Valley. Dinner is a top choice, and prices are in line with a discerning traveler. Breakfast was good, nothing extraordinary, but in line with international standards. All in all, except for one thing: the soundproofing of the rooms. From your room, you'll hear every noise from the common areas and adjacent rooms (pleasant or not, depending on your tastes), and if you're unlucky enough to have particularly loud neighbors, your experience might not be the most pleasant. For a hotel of this type, I think this is a rather significant shortcoming.

google_reviews.text: We were in this hotel after doing the route Valbone-Teth. As soon as we entered into the place we felt that it was not a hotel, but a guest house. It was a very cozy place. The girl who was in charge of the hotel was really kind and interested into our well-being. We had a great dinner and she recommended us the best way to use our time, so that we could see all what we wanted. In the room I have selected 4 stars instead of 5 because of a problem with the shower, to drainage the water, so that the guest house can improve in that aspect.

google_reviews.text: The inability to get to the apartment by car, we had to walk uphill with heavy suitcases 1.3 km and it took us 30 minutes, the climb is quite steep, it was not written about it anywhere, we were not ready for it, it was not comfortable at all. The breakfasts were terrible, there were two plates for two people - on 1 there were 2 eggs and two small slices of tomato, two pieces of goat cheese. On the 2nd plate - two pancakes (they were rubbery and tasteless) some fried dough and bread. In my opinion, this is a very meager breakfast, if there are two people, they could give 2*2 eggs, etc. Although the owner of the apartment tried to be nice, it felt like the person was not sincere and trying to play nice and friendly. We were there for two days, we came for the second breakfast at 9, as agreed, she looked at the clock with obvious dissatisfaction and then came up to us in a nice way and asked what we would like to drink, coffee or tea. Then she took out a marker and wrote on the sign that breakfast was until 8:45, although before that it was written that breakfast was from 7:45 - and nothing was written, a dash, and right now she decided that breakfast would be until 8:45. This behavior is completely bad. There was no hot water at all one day, we had to wash in cold water. The rooms were clean, but the solution with the bathroom without a curtain is not comfortable, water all over the bathroom. The mattress was worn out. The views from the apartment are very beautiful, the nature is really impressive here.

google_reviews.author: Adamo Varbaro
google_reviews.text:
Tucked away in the dramatic peaks of Theth, this guesthouse turned out to be the perfect base for one of the most memorable trips I’ve had in a long time. I visited with a group of friends, and from the moment we arrived, we were struck by the genuine warmth of the hosts.

We spent three fantastic days there, surrounded by stunning mountain scenery and unusually warm weather in the valley. It was the perfect setting to relax, but also to explore. Our days were filled with trekking, and despite the sunshine below, we encountered plenty of snow higher up in the mountains—an incredible contrast that made the whole experience feel even more special.

What truly set this place apart was the hospitality. The host and his family were exceptionally welcoming, always going out of their way to make sure we were comfortable and well looked after. It felt personal and sincere, not just like a service but like being welcomed into someone’s home.

The food was another highlight. We were served fresh, locally sourced dishes every day—simple, authentic, and full of flavour. After long hikes, sitting down to a home-cooked meal prepared with care was something we looked forward to every evening.

Evenings were peaceful and memorable, spent sharing stories, enjoying great food, taking in the calm atmosphere of the valley + drinking Rakija and dancing. If you’re after genuine hospitality, beautiful nature, and an authentic experience, this guesthouse in Theth is hard to beat. I’d return in a heartbeat.

The road up to the guest house is extremely rough, you need a big four by four to get up it - good ground clearance. There is good parking at the bottom and a car park half way, next to a cafe for those braving the first easier half.

google_reviews.author: Kamila Krpcová
google_reviews.text:
The Gest house is located on a really steep rocky hill. The place was very poorly marked. We arrived at dusk and we actually wandered for an hour at 200 meters looking for it. The navigation was sending us up an even steeper hill, which was no longer realistic. Fortunately, we were saved by the very kind owners of the Gest house Djelaj, who let us park at their place. They gave us directions to this accommodation, but they didn't speak English and it was very difficult to communicate. So we set off up about 600 meters up the hill, where we found another Gest house, in which they told us that the accommodation we were looking for was downstairs. No one from the accommodation answered the phone (we called in the afternoon for information about the fridge). We were about to ask to stay overnight in the guesthouse next door, but they finally called me back from this accommodation. The lady who didn't speak English and guessed it a while after the call. But she was obviously calling her son because he called me a moment later. I would really like to say thank you here, because the gentleman was very nice, spoke English and was on the phone with me for about 30 minutes to guide us to his mother's accommodation. The only thing we assessed negatively in hindsight is that it was 10 o'clock in the evening, we were completely packed, full of things, dark, stressed, almost dead phones. I asked the gentleman if he could go out on the road (we were really close, but we didn't see it). He was very nice but said that he wasn't there right now and that only his old mother was in the accommodation, who wouldn't be able to handle it. Which we completely understood, but when we finally found it, we were greeted by a really capable lady. So a bit strange. The rooms were nice, very comfortable beds, it was quite cold there but there were plenty of really big thick blankets. The bathroom was really basic. The kitchen was not accessible to us. We had the opportunity to put our things in the fridge but there were a lot of things in it and it was extremely dirty :( but the lady and I agreed through a translator to borrow an electric kettle and she made us tea. That was nice. Overall, it would have liked better signage and better communication. But it's enough for one night.
P.S. The accommodation is guarded by a large dog, he is tied up but it looks unpleasant. The owner held him with a rake when we entered 🙃

google_reviews.text:
Fatal Slip Hazard - Please read! The high point in the picture (a  little higher than the Albanian flag at the pass) is very popular spot for taking view photos,  but the passage there is narrow, with unstable stones and even experienced climbers can slip and fall past the cliff. I got there in beautiful weather when the ground was dry. The high point allows room for 4-6 people at most, and people wait at the top before the passage for their turn to go up. While I was waiting for my turn, a hiker who was trying to descend from the high point below, went down the narrow passage and put her foot in the wrong place - the stone she was stepping on shifted and she lost her balance, fell and started to slip and slide down. She disappeared from our sight. Luckily for her, she managed to grab a rock at the last moment before a fatal fall of hundreds of meters, while hanging on the cliff. With great luck and great difficulty I managed (with the help of other people) to reach her, grab her and pull her up. She scratched her hands, lost a bag that fell down, but she is fine.
It's important for me to say that she looked like an experienced hiker, with good shoes and in good shape, so it could have happened to me and anyone - she is now alive mainly thanks to great luck. It was a very scary event.
Please, climb slowly and very carefully. A good picture is not worth your life!

google_reviews.author: Svetlana Margetová
google_reviews.text:
Maja e Valbonës was one of the most breathtaking peaks I’ve ever had the chance to experience. Towering high above the Valbonë Valley, it offers a raw, untouched beauty that feels both humbling and exhilarating.

The climb up is demanding, but every step is rewarded with expanding views over the rugged landscape of the Albanian Alps. Reaching the top feels like standing on the edge of the world—sharp ridges, deep valleys, and the pure silence of the mountains all around. There’s something incredibly peaceful about being up there, far from noise, far from people, just surrounded by nature in its most powerful form.

If you're up for the challenge, Maja e Valbonës delivers a sense of freedom and perspective that stays with you long after the descent.

They have all their products from their own garden and the food was delicious! Also my friend had a stomach ache and she gave her a tea from fresh mint. They have great wifi and let you put up your tent for free at their garden+ free clean toilet and shower. She was also so kind and gave us blankets at night as it was very cold outside! Next day their lovely dog walked with us all the way to Theth (we tried to send her off home many times) so I hope she is safe home with her little puppies.😄 Overall one of the best hosts we had in Albania.

google_reviews.author: Gemma
google_reviews.text: Highly recommend stopping at this lovely spot. Our sandwich was delicious and enormous! The owners are very welcoming and the views are incredible.

google_reviews.author: Kuba
google_reviews.text: Camping with showers for free, but it would be a mistake to skip a dinner or breakfast from local farm resources from a very warm family.

google_reviews.author: Julia
google_reviews.text: I can only agree with all the other reviews. We stayed one night at the accommodation and had dinner and breakfast there. The owners are incredibly nice, the home-cooked food is delicious, and the whole atmosphere is simply wonderful!

google_reviews.author: Maike Waldenmaier
google_reviews.text:
After finishing the trail from Theth to the Valbona pass we were very happy to find this place to camp. It’s free to set up your tent and enjoy the amazing view. The host is super friendly and the food is very delicious and fresh!
Highly recommend!

google_reviews.author: JACK DOVE
google_reviews.text: An incredibly beautiful family run, charming restaurant and guesthouse. Everything seems to be hand built and made with care. The little restaurant has delicious homemade traditional food using fresh produce from their garden and animals. Beautifully maintained grounds, full of colour, with chickens and cows roaming around. Stunning views all around.

reviews.author: Caelcox 3
reviews.text_en: Don't expect a classic campsite, it's a "place to spend the night". But it's wonderful!

reviews.author: Anna Kovářová
reviews.text_en: Beautiful spot, however the owner of land first agreed to let us stay for free, then later wanted 20 euros, then when we didnt want to pay, he offered the girls can pay him in other way. Be careful here, if you're guys, you should be fine. Women, go somewhere else.

google_reviews.author: Shyqyri Nezha
google_reviews.text: Dont recommend this property. Worst experience ever. I had reserved 3 rooms but when we arrived the rooms were not suitable for the number of people I had told them. They even kicked us out in a very arrogant manner.

google_reviews.author: Edona Ymaj
google_reviews.text:
I had an amazing stay at Bujtina Malaj in Valbona! The hospitality was outstanding – the hosts were incredibly welcoming and made us feel like part of the family. The service was excellent and everything was handled with care and attention.

The location is perfect, right in the heart of Valbona, surrounded by breathtaking mountain views. The guesthouse is very clean, comfortable, and offers all the conditions needed for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.

What impressed me the most was the combination of warm hospitality, great service, and the stunning natural beauty around. I would highly recommend Bujtina Malaj to anyone visiting Valbona – it truly made our trip unforgettable!

google_reviews.author: Nass Nasss
google_reviews.text:
The guesthouse is 1.3 km from the main road, with a 300-meter uphill climb at the end… we didn't have a car, so it was difficult.

The manager doesn't offer any cooking facilities, so we had to walk down the 300 meters to the excellent hotel restaurant at the bottom… then climb the 300 meters back up…
Breakfast was served at 8:00 a.m., too late for our hike.
I wouldn't recommend it, even though the manager was helpful and kind.

google_reviews.author: Andreas Jann
google_reviews.text: Delicious food and friendly landlady

google_reviews.author: Harrold Huijbertsen
google_reviews.text: Stayed here for 1 night. Nice lady who helped me and good service. Highly recommended and a beautiful view.

google_reviews.author: Alex Jurado Delgado
google_reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel.

The staff was especially attentive: they helped us with both our return transportation and a minor booking error, resolving it quickly and kindly. We also had dinner at the hotel, and the experience was very good, with delicious dishes at a reasonable price.

As a minor point for improvement, there was a slight drain smell in the bathroom. Even so, the overall experience was very positive, and we would definitely recommend it.

google_reviews.text:
A very quiet and welcoming place; all the staff are very friendly, attentive, and helpful.

The food they prepare is very good.

google_reviews.text: The food was delicious, the view is breathtaking the waiters were very nice and polite the food didn’t take long to come out the rooms were perfect also with an amazing view and the owners were so generous and the nicest people i ever met

reviews.text_en: Campsite in a beautiful location for little money. The social facilities offer two toilets and a room with a sink, washing machine and shower without a tub :). A bit of field conditions, but nothing unbearable. Food in the restaurant is more expensive, small portions. The fresh trout was the best.

reviews.author: Anna Kovářová
reviews.text_en: Beautiful and mostly empty campsite, 5€ per person, they have a shower, breakfast and good food, far from the city so quite quiet, definitely a good choice

reviews.text_en: On the way from Theth, we checked in at the beginning of Valbonë. A nice meadow for a tent, for two people per night 10 Euros. Possibility of a hot shower in the facilities. For dinner we had trout from the local trout farm. Definitely worth it. They allowed us to leave our stuff in the back of the restaurant.

google_reviews.text: Mark's guesthouse is a gem! It's closer to the end of Teth-Valbona hiking trail than most other guest houses despite being a bit hidden/difficult to find. Mark is very kind, supplied us well with a vegetarian dinner (upon request), cold beers and a bottle of his homemade Raki. He even brought us to our bus the next morning. While the dinner is more expensive than most places, it's worth it as you save the hassle to get something from further away.

Accessible road, the most special thing was a "wild" Dhelper who was so sweet and accompanied us during the evening...

Breakfast wow organic fresh, honey, pancakes, chicken eggs that grew themselves...

The view was breathtaking with beauty. NATURE IS SUPERIOR.. thank you, bless your hands

google_reviews.author: Barış Adalan

The food was incredibly delicious. We checked in around 3 pm, and since we were hungry, the lady prepared something for us before dinner. The front garden was incredibly beautiful, filled with flowers, and the fruit and vegetable gardens on the side and back were magnificent. The blackberries and raspberries were delicious. The bathroom was shared but very clean and functional. We didn't have any problems with hot water. She prepared special hot crepes for us in the morning. I definitely recommend it.

google_reviews.author: Zeki Gucer
google_reviews.text: A lovely place in a wonderful garden. I've been traveling for a long time and have experienced extraordinary hospitality. It's definitely a comfortable, peaceful, and enjoyable place.

google_reviews.text: Super nice, super friendly, super food

reviews.author: Julišššs
reviews.text_en: The lady is very nice, but she doesn't speak English. Her sons can speak English, but one of them communicated with us very disrespectfully and his mother did all the ironing for him. The price for the tent is 7€ per night, lunch 7€, breakfast 5€.

reviews.author: Renata Olszewska
reviews.text_en: Camping with mountain views, close to hiking trails. Flat terrain. Shared toilet and shower for women and men, access to a washing machine. Reasonable prices. Very nice owner. No working wi-fi.

reviews.text_en: Awesome place, view on mountain is awesome, facilities are fine!

google_reviews.author: Matas Zaksas
google_reviews.text: Very warm welcome, nice owners, drove us to the start of the hike, provided us with homemade rakia, and allowed us to use the washing machine. The food was homemade and delicious. Thank you for the warm welcome!

The hosts are very friendly and helpful. The sanitary facilities are basic but clean. We'd love to come back again ☺️

google_reviews.author: Ashleigh Fletcher
google_reviews.text: Incredible campsite with great views, great price and very friendly hosts. 100% recommend!

reviews.author: Jitka Krocová
reviews.text_en: I cannot rate the accommodation in the apartments, as we slept in our own tent here. The owners let us sleep anywhere in the garden for 5€. There was no water running in the toilets and they were very dirty. We didn't sleep at all at night, as the water pump was being turned on all night, which of course no one told us about. The owners also walked around all evening, shouting at each other and talking very loudly. If you have your own tent and want to get a good night's sleep, it is better to go somewhere else.

google_reviews.author: Kristina Bogdani
google_reviews.text: Such a wonderful experience. The room was simple and very clean, with a wonderful balcony view of the breathtaking Alps. The host was a very polite man, and too helpful. They served us a nice delicious breakfast. The price was very reasonable too. If you are looking for a calm and simple experience, that’s the place.

reviews.text_en: These bunkers are an icon of Albania. Apparently, there are tens of thousands of them all over the country. Either way, it’s quite an interesting thing, so they are definitely worth seeing.

reviews.author: Marian Petreje
reviews.text_en: It is not possible to get to the bunker, it is fenced with a sign saying private property.

google_reviews.author: Copélie Pravaz
google_reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné deux nuits chez Hyrie, nous avons rarement rencontré quelqu’un d’aussi gentille et accueillante. La chambre était très bien. La nourriture était vraiment délicieuse, une des meilleures d’Albanie. Nous avons même pu lui demander un pique-nique à emporter pour notre longue randonnée. Je ne peux pas manger de gluten et Hyrie m’a très gentiment fait une pain sans gluten.
Nous y étions hors saison, fin avril, ce qui était très agréable, nous avons eu une météo incroyable. Les randonnées dans le coin sont très belles. Je recommande à 100%.

google_reviews.author: Graham Johnson
google_reviews.text: Fantastic spot to stay! Very welcoming host, 5 star gourmet multiple course dinner for only 10 euros. Can’t recommend this place enough. Highly recommend if you are needing to stay in Valbone.

google_reviews.author: Maddie Klaassen
google_reviews.text: This was the most amazing little guesthouse in Valbone! Everything was perfect - the host, the room, the views, and especially the food! For only 10 euros we had an AMAZING dinner that was HUGE! Best food we had in all of the Balkans was prepared by our host at our time of choosing! Highly recommended😊

google_reviews.author: The Travelling Mermaid
google_reviews.text: Really good guesthouse. The host was very friendly. The breakfast & optional dinner was decisions. Highly recommended.

google_reviews.author: Emilia Raschi
google_reviews.text:
Excellent dinner and breakfast! Homemade food, and the owner asked us what time we wanted to eat, which was great. The place where it's served is also very cozy with a heater.
They had extra blankets and a hairdryer, which was really helpful because of the cold. She also offered us coffee as soon as we arrived. Thank you for your hospitality!

google_reviews.author: Ayoub Ag
google_reviews.text:
We booked two nights here, but the experience was so bad that we left after just one night — we simply couldn’t stay any longer.

The room had no heating, it was freezing cold, and I ended up getting sick. We had to sleep wearing several layers just to try to stay warm. On top of that, there was no hot water, so even taking a shower was impossible.

The breakfast was only acceptable if you’re okay with very small portions, and the woman working there was loud and rude to other guests.

Overall, it was an awful experience. We paid for two nights but escaped after one because it was unbearable. I truly don’t wish this on anyone.

Of all the places I've stayed while traveling, this has undoubtedly been the most comfortable. Everything was perfect: the rooms were comfortable, the owner was incredibly kind (a seven out of ten!), the included breakfast was delicious and very filling, giving us plenty of energy to start our hike. The view is beautiful, and honestly, everything was unbeatable.

One detail that was much appreciated: the owner himself drove us to the trailhead in his car. Thank you so much for your hospitality!

The included breakfast was delicious and we also ate lunch and dinner there (dishes are €5-7 each) and purchased a packed lunch for the hike (€3). All the food was delicious and generous, the chicken, chips and salad is the best dish! This was my favourite place I stayed during my trip to Albania. We will always remember Albert’s kindness

google_reviews.text:
I got the villa for my husband’s birthday and expected to pay €135 for 3 nights. When we arrived, everything was fine but there was no toilet roll, no shower gel (just 1 bottle of head and shoulders) , no WiFi, no furniture on the balcony, no water provided and no coffee or kettle which seemed a bit ridiculous for €135 per night but we thought we’d leave it as it was my husband’s birthday evening and we had a hot tub so we thought we’d make the most of it the next day after a hike.

We are both wildlife filmmakers and are happy with very basic accommodation but we thought we’d splash out for a special day.

However, the hot tub was leaking the next day and I told the managers about it and asked if we could have a reduction in cost as their cheaper rooms are €60 for the same level of service we were getting. I messaged the manager after dinner and he said: “
“If you’re not satisfied, please let me know what you think is fair and I’m happy to pay accordingly. You can also check out tomorrow if that works better, and I’ll do my best to fix everything. I’m really sorry for any inconvenience, and I truly appreciate your understanding 😊”

I said the other rooms are €60 for the same quality that we were getting and he immediately became hostile and told us to leave the next day. I said I didn’t want to ruin our holiday so we would just leave it and pay the full amount but he didn’t want to accept that and told us to either pay the full amount or to leave the next day. I said we would just pay the full amount because I didn’t want ruin our holiday and I just wanted to give him constructive feedback. This is when he changed his mind AGAIN and forced us to leave the next morning.

If you stay here DO NOT book the more expensive accommodation. It seems like a scam because you don’t get what you pay for at all! Go for the cheaper accommodation if you decide to stay! It is nowhere near worth €135 per night for what you’re getting! There are much nicer places around and for the same quality but for less money

google_reviews.author: Fatjon Brahaj
google_reviews.text:
An absolutely outstanding experience in the heart of Valbona!
Without a doubt, this is the best place to stay and enjoy the breathtaking beauty of the area. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the rooms are comfortable, clean, and well-maintained in every detail.
The food is simply fantastic—each dish is prepared with care and authentic flavor, making every bite a real pleasure. Fresh, traditional ingredients give you a true taste of Valbona’s cuisine.
What truly makes this place special is the hospitality. The staff and owners are incredibly kind, always ready to help, and make you feel right at home. It’s one of those places where you arrive as a guest and leave as a friend.
A perfect choice for anyone looking for peace, quality, and an unforgettable experience in Valbona. I will definitely be coming back!

google_reviews.author: Bleona Jashari
google_reviews.text:
I absolutely loved this guesthouse. It’s family-run, and you can really feel the warmth and hospitality from the moment you arrive. The room was clean, had a private bathroom, and everything felt new and well kept.

Dinner was traditional and hearty, with plenty of vegetarian options too. That night there was a football match (Albania was playing!) and when we asked if they could show it, the host said they weren’t airing it but was driving into town to watch and invited us to join. We went, and it was such a great experience, locals and tourists all cheering together.

In the morning, they served a proper Balkan breakfast and even set out everything to make sandwiches for the hike. The lady who cooked (the host’s mother, I think) was the sweetest person ever. She secretly gave us some leftover cake and clementines to take on the trail. The family also arranged a cheap shuttle to the trailhead and even the driver (the dad) gave us tips for the hike.

It honestly felt like staying at a relative’s house. The kind of place that makes you smile the whole way up the mountain.

google_reviews.author: Paul
google_reviews.text: A lovely, family-run guesthouse with a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. The owners are incredibly friendly and make sure you have everything you need. The dining and community room with its fireplace is the perfect place to socialize and the food is freshly prepared and delicious. Plus, there are a few friendly cats to cuddle with! You can really feel that they care about their guests and want everyone to feel at home.

The nicest family! I only stayed one night at the guesthouse before the hike but was touched by the warmth and genuine kindness of Faria, Arben and Gazi. The rooms are wcharming, the burek was delicious and the views are amazing. I hope to be back soon!

We stayed on the upper floor of the annex to the owner's house in a large room with sloping walls. There is a large bed consisting of two wide single beds pushed together, which is incredibly comfortable to sleep in.

Downstairs is a clean bathroom with a toilet and a bidet. The whole setup includes very reliable Wi-Fi.

You can park your car across the grass close to the hostess's house, and the gate is hermetically sealed all day long.

You can have dinner with the owner in the evening. You get a very generous portion, and all the Albanian food she prepares tastes exquisite.

The breakfast she offers in the morning is also fantastic. For example, there are delicious homemade treats and super tasty homemade jam.

The owner is a fantastic woman who goes to great lengths to make your stay enjoyable. Even though we were here for just one night, I would recommend it to everyone.

google_reviews.text:
We stayed 2 days in this slice of heaven! Everything was amazing from the start to end - we had many laughs with Drita who welcomed us like family and showed us around, cooked delicious, local food, with produce from her garden. The view is also incredible! Extremely comfortable bed and it was nice being a little bit outside of Valbone.
If you want a local experience with a warm host- stay here! If you’re vegan or have dietary restrictions she does her best to accommodate all of them but also remember you’re in rural Albania and as a visitor you should respect their way of life. Don’t be a turist budalla! Much love, Drita! See you next time. Chris from Canada

google_reviews.author: Stephany gonzalez reyes
google_reviews.text: We stayed with Drita! And the spot was outstanding, clean, authentic, and with everything we needed! I would stay here and you should stay here if you can and you love nature! Also, this is a cultural exchange so be open to learn about Albanian culture, agriculture,  and food! Be open to exploring what Albanian cuisine is! This bed and breakfast offered a breakfast, which is a cultural immersion ( please appreciate it). This was my favourite location during my whole time in Albania. Thank you Drita! Stephany from Colombia will come back.

google_reviews.author: Orr Teva (Orr)
google_reviews.text: Guesthouse Relax/Guesthouse Niko in Cerem was the perfect introduction into life in Albania with very comfortable accommodations, a truly lovely host family, and stunning views. I arrived late after a long hike and was immediately welcomed and shown to my room which had very comfortable beds. The family cooked a wonderful dinner and sat with me the whole time, asking questions about life in America. I was given beer and I talked with the family for many hours, feeling so welcomed and cared for the whole evening. In the morning, I was served a delicious breakfast and was directed to the road to continue my hiking. The kindness and hospitality of the hosts was truly remarkable and the stay was so comfortable and relaxing. 10/10, I could not recommend this choice enough.

This meant we couldn't ventilate and had to keep the curtains closed at all times. The entire house is incredibly noisy; it seems no insulation was installed. The owners are very friendly and speak good English. Dinner and breakfast are prepared by all the guests together, which is lovely. The garden is inviting. Everything in the old house appears to be quite outdated. The shared bathroom seems to have only one drain (for both the toilet and shower). Guests are responsible for preparing their own packed lunches.

google_reviews.author: Konsti F.
google_reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay at GuestHouse VITA in Cerem! The family is incredibly kind and welcoming, and we felt right at home from the moment we arrived. The host prepared amazing homemade food for both dinner and breakfast — selfmade cheese, butter, olives, jam, vegetables from the garden, and so much more. The portions were huge, and everything was delicious! The warm fireplace in the common room made the atmosphere even cozier. We stayed in one of the new wooden cabins outside, which was modern, comfortable, and had hot water. It might not be the cheapest option in Cerem, but it offers the best value for money — and it’s refreshingly authentic, without the pushy roadside offers you find elsewhere. One of the best places we stayed on the Peaks of the Balkans!

We stayed here as a group of 4 who had been wild camping but ran out of food. The host was so lovely and welcoming and really looked after us - even gave us her tent as we were just using a poncho.
She (sorry I’ve forgotten your name!) made sure we were well fed and watered and we had everything we needed for the hike.
The food portions are good - a family style, you get given a portioned amount of certain things but then can help yourself you bread, rice, cheese ect.
The host was really caring and would go out of her way to help us.

Highly recommend and would definitely be back,
Thank you so much!

I read the reviews about this place and I absolutely cannot agree with the 3.8 rating.
We were there last year. Although we couldn't get our motorcycles in, the hosts arranged a parking space for us in the town with a family where we could safely leave our motorcycles, and they took us and our luggage up the mountain in their car.
We were treated to a delicious dinner and a cold beer.
The rooms were well-kept and clean, and the beds were very comfortable. In the morning, after breakfast, we were driven back to the town, and no one even asked us to pay extra for the transfer.
The guesthouse is really good, and the hosts are very kind and helpful. The view of the surrounding area is breathtaking.
I wholeheartedly recommend this place to everyone, and if I were to find accommodation in this area, I would choose the hospitality of Eco Village Jasavić again.

We were offered tea upon request, and for dinner, we had warm soup and a truly generous meal in a fairly large, very warm common room. We were surprised by how much time they dedicated to our meal.

The rooms are simple, as is typical, but perfectly adequate.

Here, you're supporting local people, not the big hotels.

We stayed here for two nights. The house is surrounded by beautiful mountain views. The location is amazing.
The hosts are very pleasant people. They prepared breakfasts and dinners for us.
There was also a sauna, which was a very nice bonus. Bathrobes and towels were provided.
The pillows and mattresses were excellent – not every hotel/house has such comfortable beds.
The access to hiking trails was also convenient.

There were a few minor downsides: the toilet tank was leaking, it was a bit chilly at night (but we were given a small heater), the hot/cold water in the shower was not easy to adjust, and the soundproofing between rooms was very poor.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay – many thanks to the hosts!

We were having a bad luck streak, the place we booked was empty and luckly Maria helped us.
First time i felt at home in another country.
If i ever come back i know where I'm going to stay.

Thank you so much!

google_reviews.author: Albana
google_reviews.text: The best people very respectful original Food I like to stay as much as I can in this place thank you Maria & Gjon

google_reviews.author: שרה דנה
google_reviews.text:
Lovely hosts!
Very warm and homely
Maria's food is very delicious and very cheap to order for dinner

We got a lovely and clean room of a very high standard!
Excellent bed and finally very good pillows
There was boiling water all day long.

We will definitely be back!

google_reviews.author: Manel Martinez
google_reviews.text: We were there from October 9 to 12 and let's be clear, if what you want is tranquility and spectacular views it is one of the best places in Theth. The hostess is a sweetheart and her husband very helpful. We went with a scooter and although it was expensive to get there it was worth it. If what you are looking for are services, shops and restaurants, better Benidorm. One of the best experiences I have had, lots of peace and nature.

google_reviews.author: Carolina Glez
google_reviews.text:
The hostess was lovely, the place is very clean, and the views are incredible. If you go off-season, get dinner at the accommodation; it's €25 for two people and quite substantial, plus there's nothing else open.
The only downside is the road to get there…it's awful.

google_reviews.author: Ramadan
google_reviews.text: Stayed for one night with my friends 4 of us. It’s a little bit far but worth it. Especially the dinner option

google_reviews.author: Danielle Gov
google_reviews.text: A really simple place. Hosts were extremely nice. The rooms are rather simple and old fashioned but very clean. Location wise it’s a bit far from Theth center which is a minus when coming from the Valbone-Theth hike but a huge plus when doing the Theth-Vusanje hike (which is longer).

google_reviews.author: Lilil
google_reviews.text:
The hostess makes an effort, is kind, helpful, and the food was great, and the location for hiking is unbeatable. But... The toilet wouldn't flush, our room smelled of urine, silverfish were crawling up the walls, the carpet was dirty, showering next to the toilet would completely soak it, you could hear people snoring in the next room, and driving there requires an off-road vehicle.
A guard dog (or two, we couldn't identify exactly) is locked in a cardboard-sized kennel and, in our opinion, never gets out to exercise. We don't know if it's their pet, but elderly people who lived in the same building went there to feed the other animals, which is why we would attribute the caged dog to them. I also had to watch as an employee repeatedly hit a dog with a broom while it was trying to shelter itself from the heavy rain, even when it was already on the ground. I'll never forget that image.

reviews.author: Dan Rybář
reviews.text_en: Terribly nice and helpful owner, breakfast included, dinner was also included, room upstairs clean, as well as shared bathroom and toilet

google_reviews.author: Vincent Klee
google_reviews.text: Lola is a sweetheart of a host. Super friendly and warm hearted. Room and bathroom clean and tidy, stunning Mountain View and delicious home made breakfast from her own garden and animals.

google_reviews.author: Sören B.
google_reviews.text: Great accommodation. Top-notch breakfast, incredibly delicious optional dinner with home-grown produce. Stunning panorama. The drive is adventurous, but also possible without a four-wheel drive. A truly lovely host family.

google_reviews.author: Dacqmar Guascoine
google_reviews.text:
We stayed at Butjina Milani for 3 nights. When I say it is a little piece of paradise - I'm not joking. Claudia and her grandparents made us feel right at home, with a delicious breakfast every morning (which we couldn't wait for) complete with home made cheese, bread and eggs.

The room was comfortable and cool - a necessity during Europe's summer heatwave and a beautiful peaceful morning to wake to!

We would suggest everyone stay here if they can! We would have stayed longer if we could!

reviews.author: Pavel Tic
reviews.text_en: No longer available. The exits to the property are blocked.

google_reviews.author: Jozef Rrahishta
google_reviews.text:
The house is one of the nicest house in the valley, the views are stunning and breathtaking.
Rooms are comfortable and very clean.
Pjeter and File are great hosts.

google_reviews.author: Jorys Gorgeret
google_reviews.text:
Superb host, very welcoming and kind.

The house is superb for a short stay in Theth, with magnificent views of the Albanian Alps.

Please note that the guesthouse does not include meals and is located approximately 1 hour 30 minutes on foot or 15 minutes by car from the center of Theth.

google_reviews.author: Niko Heine
google_reviews.text:
A very large and beautiful guesthouse with an adjacent campground.

The host, Pjeter, is very friendly and gives lots of helpful tips. In the evenings, he sometimes serves raki. ;)

The view from the garden is breathtaking. There are also plenty of places to sit and relax in the garden.

There are many beautiful hiking trails nearby, and the walk down to the village is also easily manageable.

There's a waterfall nearby where you can get clean drinking water.

google_reviews.author: Danielle Broadbent
google_reviews.text:
This guesthouse is the perfect place to stay in Theth. It’s out of the way of the main touristy part of the valley but close enough to walk to - takes about an hour. The journey by the back route (not the main road) is beautiful. Pjeter was so friendly and drove us into the valley, helping us to find transport to the Blue Eye.
Everybody here was so friendly. My friend and I were the only people staying for 3 nights so we managed to take a room each instead of sharing. The space is perfect. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kazimierz Kulma
reviews.text_en: Free camping, but it is good to order something in the restaurant, friendly service, clean toilets and shower, beautiful views, the access is a bit difficult, but you can get there slowly by car.

google_reviews.author: Tomas Tom
google_reviews.text: Great

google_reviews.author: Albana
google_reviews.text:
If you’re looking for the most peaceful escape imaginable, Zemra e Traditës in Theth is truly a hidden gem. 🌞Surrounded by breathtaking, almost unreal views, this place leaves you speechless from the very first moment. The tranquility here is something you rarely experience—pure, untouched calm.

What makes the experience even more special is the incredible hospitality. Amarildo😊, the owner, personally picked us up with his car, making the journey so much easier and more comfortable. You immediately feel welcomed like family.

The food is unforgettable—don’t miss the chicken with pilaf, it’s an absolute must! And the fresh petulla for breakfast? Simply delicious.

A special mention goes to Andrea✨, the waiter—an extremely polite and kind young man who brought such a positive vibe. He blended perfectly with the group and even turned into a fantastic DJ, making our evenings so much fun.

A place where nature, comfort, and warm-hearted people come together beautifully. Highly recommended!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

google_reviews.author: Elidiana Peci
google_reviews.text: Beautifuel plane, I love it

reviews.author: Kazimierz Kulma
reviews.text_en: Free camping, but it is good to order something in the restaurant, friendly service, clean toilets and shower, beautiful views, the access is a bit difficult, but you can get there slowly by car.

google_reviews.author: Kjeld
google_reviews.text: Guest House Çarku wordt gerund door een vriendelijke gastvrije familie. De zoon spreekt het best Engels, en is daarmee gastheer en aanspreekpunt. De moeder voorziet de gasten 's ochtends en 's avonds naar wens van heerlijke traditionele maaltijden. De kamer was relatief nieuw, en ondanks het compacte formaat voorzien van alle comfort en benodigdheden. Een absolute aanrader!

google_reviews.author: Juan Rangel Tornay
google_reviews.text: I made the reservation and they cancelled it without telling me anything, even though we had the trip all arranged. At least send a message explaining why.

google_reviews.author: Eugene
google_reviews.text: One of the nicest host we have met during our stat in Albania, we walked in when driving to Theth and he greeted us with a big smile and also provide us useful guides to visit Theth. We also had a nice dinner in the guest house. Although we are the only guest, the host treated us with high hospitality and we had a nice talk sharing our stories together! The room is clean, warm and with interest provided! Highly recommended!

google_reviews.author: Sven Ihlenfeld
google_reviews.text: A wonderful place with very warm-hearted people!

reviews.author: Patrik Bimbo
reviews.text_en: Great camp, in a superb environment, with home-cooked meals on offer

reviews.author: Štefan Holeš
reviews.text_en: Bad road access for a camper van.

google_reviews.author: benita
google_reviews.text: I can only echo the previous comments... so much better up here than down below for a variety of reasons: the view, the great food, and the incredibly welcoming hosts. A wonderful, welcoming family business that deserves our support. Absolute peace and quiet all day long and a 4 km walk down to the village on unpaved paths. Everything was perfect, and thank you so much for everything! Great people, great place!! Highly recommended.

google_reviews.author: Agnieszka Wójcik
google_reviews.text: Perfect place! Beautiful views, friendly owners, delicious food. I highly recommend it!

google_reviews.author: Ruaridh Phillips
google_reviews.text:
A super nice and secluded campground above the main village of Theth. I camped and ate dinner here for several nights and had a great time. Excellent views and alpenglow in the evenings.
The food is really nice and the family running it are great. They even made me a sandwich at short notice really early one day before a long hike! Much appreciated! They also take PayPal as well as cash, which was handy.

google_reviews.author: Arek Pustolka
google_reviews.text:
Przepiękne miejsce z pysznym jedzeniem i przemiłymi Paniami.
Widoki naprawdę zapierają dech w piersiach.
Droga jest wyboista i kamienista więc trzeba jechać ostrożnie ale miejsce to wynagradza.
Polecam!

google_reviews.author: Sedat Akkaş
google_reviews.text: Up on the mountain, you have a stove which has wood fire whole day, you have your delicious breakfast and dinner made by a lovely woman feels like grandma, during the dinner a grandpa approach you and try to give you palm raki made by him, there are smiles, warmth, and you have the great view of Alps. Its such a pleasure

google_reviews.author: Ananth raj Jayasankar
google_reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An absolute highlight of our trip to Theth!
We stayed here before heading out toward Kotor and it was the perfect mountain escape. The stone architecture is stunning and the atmosphere is so peaceful. The rooms are clean, cozy, and offer incredible views of the Albanian Alps. What really made it special was the hospitality—you truly feel like a guest in a family home. Highly recommend for anyone looking for an authentic experience in Theth!

google_reviews.author: prajwal jadhav
google_reviews.text: Beautiful rooms and excellent service, but what truly stands out are the incredibly kind owners. I’m genuinely touched by their hospitality—thank you for such a wonderful stay.

google_reviews.author: Prasanth MP
google_reviews.text: I stayed 2 nights in theth . Roza and leka who run the hostel were kind and welcome like your own home. The beds are comfortable, super clean , warm and hot water always .the breakfast is fulfilling and they also served dinner and prices are very reasonable. Definitely will visit them again . Thank you Roza and Leka 🤗 see you again . Prasanth

google_reviews.author: Nikola Ganchev
google_reviews.text: We went for dinner and liked it a lot. It was a fixed menu where you only pick the type of pasta and meat, but everything is cooked on the spot. It's simple, but very fresh and delicious. Highly recommend.

google_reviews.author: Ema Stoyanova
google_reviews.text: Food was tasty and at a great price, the family that runs the place is very welcoming.

google_reviews.author: Scott van den Heuvel
google_reviews.text: A lot of food for a small price

google_reviews.author: Philippe Mariette
google_reviews.text: The owner is very pleasant and speaks excellent English, which makes things much easier. That day, there was no set menu, just standard plates: fries, carrots, peppers, eggplant, olives (excellent), cheese, a small hamburger, and pasta with pesto. Two plates were enough for the three of us, although a larger piece of meat would have been welcome. It was far from the hustle and bustle of some places, and all that with two large beers and two soft drinks for 38 euros. Don't hesitate, especially if you like peace and quiet and a mountain view.

google_reviews.author: Søren Therkildsen
google_reviews.text: Great food compared to prices from other restaurants in this area. Nothing fancy, but good local food. Great service - the place is hosted by a very friendly family. We got pork, fries and salad for 22 euro for 2 persons.

reviews.author: Lukas Bodek
reviews.text_en: Excellent accommodation, home environment. Luxurious price-performance ratio 😉

reviews.author: Petr Ciganek
reviews.text_en: Amazing..! Cozy and clean rooms, great cuisine, extremely hospitable owners.. ten stars out of five..!

reviews.author: Katka Houskova
reviews.text_en: Great accommodation for families. Children really like it here.

google_reviews.author: Amy St Lawrence
google_reviews.text: The most beautiful, welcoming, family-run guesthouse, set in a stunning location. Thank you to Rafael and family, Michael, Christian, the other staff and the adorable puppy Molly! We will never forget our visit to Theth. From the Australian family who visited in April 2026.

google_reviews.author: Tom Nicholson
google_reviews.text: The type of place that ends with handshakes & hugs after 3 days. Stunning views, perfectly kept guesthouse, excellent food & immense hospitality. We are already talking about our next trip.

google_reviews.author: Małgorzata Skumiał
google_reviews.text: Peace and quiet, a wonderful place worth recommending. The views are breathtaking, the food is excellent, the staff is wonderful and always very helpful, and the rooms are very atmospheric. I hope to return to Theth and then definitely to Molla 🩷

google_reviews.author: Kristja N
google_reviews.text:
The best place to stay in Theth . Very quiet , beatiful location , amazing food
I will come back

google_reviews.author: Kevin V
google_reviews.text:
What an incredible stay we had at La Molla GH! Nestled in the heart of the Albanian Alps, the location is peaceful and relaxing, away from the more crowded areas. The views from every side of the house are breathtaking. The rooms are very clean and comfortable. The food is delicious, and the staff is welcoming and attentive. Numerous hikes are easily accessible, including the trek to Valbona.

We were sad to leave when it was time to depart. Thank you for your hospitality and this perfect stay that we will never forget. Farewell!

google_reviews.author: Orgesa Qipo
google_reviews.text:
My friends and I had such a lovely stay at Bujtina Terthorja in Theth. The food was incredible, and the spacious yard offered stunning mountain views and a truly peaceful atmosphere. We especially loved relaxing in the hammock and soaking in the beauty of nature.

The hosts were exceptionally kind and welcoming. They even came to pick us up when one of our friends got injured while hiking, which we deeply appreciated.
We would absolutely come back again!

google_reviews.author: aleksy gaj
google_reviews.text:
Stayed in Theth, Albania and had an amazing experience. The staff were incredibly kind and went above and beyond—when one of us got injured during a hike, they came to pick us up and really took care of us.

The location is perfect for exploring some of the most beautiful hikes in the area, and the views are unreal. One of the highlights was their hammock setup—perfectly placed under the shade of a tree with stunning mountain views. Easily one of the most relaxing spots we found.

google_reviews.author: JAQUELINE MUÑOZ MARQUEZ
google_reviews.text: I loved my stay at this hotel, food was delicious, the views were amazing, and the rooms were very clean. I would definitely come back in the future.

google_reviews.author: Robertas
google_reviews.text: Really great stay overall. Everything was very clean, the beds were comfortable, and the hosts were friendly and welcoming. The dinner was definitely worth it as well. Would happily stay here again!

google_reviews.author: Giedre Prakopimaite
google_reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay here! The hosts are such warm and kind people – so friendly and always ready to help with anything. They gave us great recommendations and really made us feel at home. Breakfast was just amazing – all homemade with so much love, even the butter, and the cheese came from a local farm. The mountain view is breathtaking, and the place is so calm and peaceful – we slept like babies. Truly a wonderful experience, we would come back in a heartbeat! 💛

google_reviews.author: MvL
google_reviews.text: Perfect location for exploring the surrounding mountains. Very nice hosts, delicious home made food in the morning and evening

google_reviews.author: Diego Zambrana Calleja
google_reviews.text:
A magical place, the owner is lovely, and so is her son! Delicious homemade food and spectacular views of the Albanian Alps.

100% recommended.

google_reviews.author: Julie & Paul Tokarski
google_reviews.text: Cette guest house est superbe. Idéalement placée au coeur des montagnes avec une vue imprenable sur Theth. Les hôtes sont très sympathiques. Les photos sont conformes. La nourriture est bonne ! À ne pas manquer 👌

google_reviews.author: Jozefina GjonPjetri
google_reviews.text: The best❤️

google_reviews.author: Nadine Moessle
google_reviews.text: Here, you don't feel like just another guest, but like part of the family. Thank you so much, Astrid, Marinella, and Nicolas! 😃 We would definitely come back again! 😃

google_reviews.author: Sommerregen
google_reviews.text:
An absolute highlight of our Albania tour! We were only here for two nights, but we felt incredibly comfortable and would definitely stay longer next time! The individual houses for overnight stays still look very new and are furnished in a modern and stylish way. They have everything you need. The view of the mountains from the bed is simply breathtaking!

We felt completely at ease with Astrit and his family, and you can tell how much heart and soul they've put into this place. The paths are beautifully landscaped, and both breakfast and dinner were delicious! You eat with a view of the mountains, and the sweet, but also cheeky, family cat occasionally wanders by. The son always took great care of us during meals and was very attentive!

An absolute recommendation if you want to stay in Theth! Just be careful to find the access road and avoid damaging your car due to the unpaved surface.
